title: Fix quiz dataset module integrity and add pre-build validation gate for AAB packaging

requirements.summary: Repair malformed/truncated quiz question data modules so they parse and export a default array for Class 6–10.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the frontend build succeeds without syntax/module-parse errors from any questions_*.js file.
Each questions data file ends with a complete, syntactically valid `export default [...]` (no unterminated strings/objects/arrays).
The app can navigate through quiz level selection and start a quiz for Class 6–10 without crashing at import time.

requirements.summary: Add a pre-build questions integrity check script that imports Class 6–10 datasets and runs existing `validateQuestions` logic, failing with clear English errors.
acceptanceCriteria: A single command/script can be run locally (and in CI/build environments) to validate all question files and fail fast with an actionable error indicating which class level failed.

If a questions file has the wrong shape (e.g., missing question/options/correct answer fields) the validator reports the first offending question with context (level + question number) using the existing validation behavior.
If a questions file cannot be imported due to syntax errors, the check fails and prints which file/level could not be loaded.

file_operations.description: Create a Node-runnable integrity check that imports each dataset (questions.js, questions_class7.js, questions_class8.js, questions_class9.js, questions_class10.js), runs `validateQuestions` from frontend/src/quiz/validateQuestions.ts, prints a clear English error including the failing class level (and underlying validator message), and exits non-zero on any failure.
Document how to run the questions integrity check locally (single command) and how to interpret failures (syntax/import failure vs validation failure with class level + question index context).

requirements.summary: Update the Android AAB release workflow to run the questions integrity check before Bubblewrap init/build and fail fast with a clear error.
acceptanceCriteria: When the questions integrity check fails, build-release-aab.sh exits before `bubblewrap init`/`bubblewrap build` and prints an English error describing that question data must be fixed first.
When the questions integrity check passes, the script proceeds as before and can produce an AAB (assuming external prerequisites like Java/Android SDK/keystore are correct).

file_operations.description: Run the questions integrity check (REQ-5) immediately after switching into the frontend directory and before any Bubblewrap initialization/build steps; if validation fails, print a clear English error instructing to fix question data first and exit non-zero.
